Shared session, review invalidation and host/printer controller isolation
Exact fresh/historical composition, preservation and restoration

constraints.text: For fresh composition and the exact historical overlay, enumerate every changed/new file and directory with before/after hashes, modes and ownership. Test that all preimages are checked before any mutation and restoration checks all afterimages before restoring/deleting anything; unexpected bytes, metadata or concurrent drift must refuse without partial restoration. Exercise interrupted publication so host navigation never exposes missing panel assets and originals remain recoverable; report per-file rather than all-file atomicity where applicable. Include host-only staging/refresh regressions. Quantify root payload, temporary/backup peak blocks and inodes against existing factory8GB reserves, preserving the accepted private-feature limits and unchanged backend/runtime closure.

Add a delayed or lost-acknowledgment inactive-apply journey spanning section navigation and Stop/logout/disconnect. Navigation or authority changes must invalidate reviews/delayed UI results without claiming an already submitted save/apply was cancelled. Reconcile saved revision/context explicitly before another mutation, preserve any dirty local draft during that reconciliation and never replay automatically. Cover the host upload/review cancellation path in relevant host regressions as well as printer review, import/export/save/cancel; installed navigation acceptance may remain read-only and need not repeat candidate application.

decision.rationale: The actual owner-request.md explicitly replaces the standalone-link UX; no further owner decision is required. At reviewed HEAD 4392f2ba3a336ac0dd02ecb651aec38cc86960b0, ui/host/index.html links to a separate document and ui/printer/index.html duplicates the header/session. The installed-evidence.md and theme-correction.md establish the existing accepted component workflow and source-bound theme evidence, not integrated-shell acceptance. ui/host/app.js has document-wide main-button failure handlers, while ui/printer/app.js reloads saved state on reauthorization: the proposal explicitly addresses these concrete isolation/draft risks. stage_printer_ui.py currently supports only an additive link and refuses existing printer payload; stage_admin_ui.py refresh replaces the host directory and requires current core inputs. Neither is suitable unchanged for the historical installed overlay. Preserve exact historical host bytes outside uniquely matched navigation/control-isolation boundaries; HEAD at 85cb5c7 is a before-UX reference, not an installed preimage. The prior component approval remains applicable to backend, catalog, persistence, limits and safety; its separate-page condition is superseded by the owner correction. Decision0012 and host-admin-cockpit.md support reuse of the pinned Cockpit337 adapter and existing privileged bridge. Ordinary second-package navigation reproduces the reported problem; replacing the selected shell or adding an iframe/dependencies is unnecessary. Compare source-bound before/after document identity, sidebar/session continuity, captures and dirty-state journeys. Evidence levels remain offline composition/browser/regression versus actual authenticated installed ARM64 checks on test-sv08-01; neither establishes physical compatibility, commissioning or release. Constraints below close multi-file recovery and asynchronous-outcome acceptance gaps without expanding backend scope. Preserve heater protections, idle admission, generation/CAS persistence, 8GB reserves, profiles, pins and recovery; H12 exclusions and deferred physical checks remain intact. This approves design/offline work only, grants no hardware authority and requires independent delivery verification. Workflow validate passed for42features/54tasks; next returned null. Hashes were recomputed from actual files and scope bound using review-context. No experimental probes, hardware/credential access or tracked edits were performed; actual runtime settings remain unknown here pending coordinator verification.
decision.reviewer: Independent feature-approver, full-role separate-session fallback; requested Sol6.1/medium; effective role/model/effort verification coordinator-owned and not attested by this review

tasks.blocker:
Failed offline software delivery at 9476304a045e0bc8b3097d056345d713a61d349a. Inspected the complete 25-path diff from recorded base 7fb2a69e38cbae6b0718df8f500b2b30d9bb9ca5, entry points, approval constraints, execution scripts, receipts and screenshots. Candidate remains clean and unchanged. Decision/proposal/requirement/scope, evidence/document/source and listed browser artifact hashes match. Executable code is unchanged since tested 86fd625. Diff checks, JSON/Markdown targets, lock/gitlink agreement and workflow validation pass.

Source-bound offline evidence supports shared navigation/session, routes/history/legacy URL, responsive layouts, dirty-value retention, host isolation, ordinary printer operations, cancelled host upload/reviews, and lost apply acknowledgment journeys without replay. Material acceptance failures remain:

F1 — Staging concurrent-drift protection: scripts/stage_printer_ui.py:200-234 checks afterimages once before restoration, without excluding concurrent writers. Independent run1 synchronized a real disposable-filesystem writer immediately before the first host-entry replacement. The writer changed printer app.js after validation; restoration deleted that content, restored the host preimage and returned restored=true without refusal. Implement and demonstrate an exclusion/consistent-snapshot strategy satisfying the approved concurrent-drift refusal and no-partial-restoration requirement for fresh and historical cases. Preserve metadata, preimage/afterimage and interruption regressions. The documentation disclaimer does not waive this constraint.

F2 — Dirty draft lost during reconciliation: ui/printer/app.js:161-163 clears draft during load(true) when status reports an unsupported catalog/schema. Independent run2 executed the unchanged controller with a bounded DOM/RPC fixture: import an unsaved geometry value 123, lose/restore authority, select keep-selections reconciliation, then return catalog_supported=false. Before export contained the local value; afterward export contained only diagnostic state/catalog. No mutation was submitted. Preserve the local draft independently of diagnostic saved state and editability; require explicit discard. Add unsupported-catalog/schema reconciliation and export-recovery checks. This is offline controller evidence, not installed behavior.

F3 — Required storage evidence incomplete: reported payload bytes, 164 4KiB blocks and three net added inodes do not establish temporary/retained-report/backup peak inode demand or comparisons against accepted factory8GB root/data reserves. Supply reproducible per-filesystem peak block/inode accounting and reserve/headroom comparisons for both fresh and historical composition. Preserve existing private-feature limits and runtime closure. Installed free-space/metadata admission can remain pending, but does not replace the requested offline calculation.

Reproduction scripts and results are in /home/drew/sv08-mainline/local/feature-workflow/probes/printer-integration-20261004/verifier/: staging_probe.py, run1-result.json, reconcile_probe.mjs and run2-result.json. Two probes used under one second of process runtime and conservatively under 4MiB generated data; the two-run allowance is exhausted. No candidate repairs, tracked edits, shared-record changes, commits, publication, remote/hardware/credential access, package installation or agents occurred. Installed authenticated acceptance remains pending; no hardware compatibility or release is certified. Repairs and new source-bound evidence require fresh independent review.
